body:
God Ape
CR 17

This enormous ape stands taller than the trees. It bellows out an earth-shaking roar while beating its massive chest in challenge.

XP 102,400
Combat (barbaric)
N Colossal animal
Init +1; Senses darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +14
Aura frightful presence (60 ft., DC 22)

DEFENSE

AC 32, touch 3, flat-footed 31 (+1 Dex, +29 natural, -8 size)
hp 273 (14d12+168)
Fort +21, Ref +10, Will +11
Defensive Abilities rock catching; DR 20/piercing

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., climb 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +26 (2d8+20 plus grab)
Ranged rock +8 (2d6+30)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 30 ft.
Special Attacks blood rage (+4 Strength and Constitution), constrict (2d8+20), powerful charge (claw, 4d8+30), rend (2 claws, 2d8+30), rock throwing (120 ft.)

STATISTICS

Str 50, Dex 13, Con 35, Int 2, Wis 24, Cha 21
Base Atk +14; CMB +42 (+46 grapple); CMD 53
Feats Cleave, Diehard, Endurance, Greater Bull Rush, Improved Bull Rush, Lunge, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +9 (+44 jumping), Climb +28, Intimidate +13, Perception +14; Racial Modifiers: Uses Strength for Acrobatics checks made to jump, +16 on Acrobatics made to jump
SQ powerful leaper

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Powerful Leaper (Ex)

The ape god uses its Strength to modify Acrobatics checks made to jump and receives a +16 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks made to jump.

ECOLOGY

Environment jungle
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

There are dense jungles where enormous apes rule all lesser life. Local tribes worship the titans, going to grand and desperate lengths to soothe their terrible anger for as long as possible. To their god they offer sacrifices of food and playthings, knowing that the ape’s wrath devastates the land worse than any natural disaster. A god ape stands 70 feet tall and weighs 260,000 pounds.
